current_bottleneck: The 293 support-object branch is now in a real tradeoff. 293d's monolithic support code is harder to predict but gives stronger structural anchoring; 293e's compositional knot-token support is easier to learn and improves some path-shape softness metrics, but it weakens the structural gains on cointegration and mean-reversion support. The next bottleneck is understanding whether there is a clean hybrid support object or whether the branch needs a harder rethink.
last_result_summary: Iteration 139 completed the 293e-v0 experiment. Compositional support improved level KS (1/25 -> 3/25), calibration, jump KS, and regime width ratio relative to 293d, but the score fell from 4/11 to 3/11 because change KS, worst-cell cointegration robustness, and MR structure regressed. The result establishes a real support-object tradeoff rather than a monotonic improvement path.
next_step_recommendation: Do post-experiment analysis comparing 293d and 293e to decide whether the next move is a clean hybrid support object or a harder family rethink.
